mentions.name: ESP32 Partition Calculator
mentions.description: An online calculator for ESP32 flash partition tables. It lets users compute ESP32 partition layouts in the browser instead of doing the math manually or using the previously available Google-Sheets-based tool.
mentions.problem: Calculating ESP32 partition layouts manually is a huge pain, and the only existing tool was Google-Sheets-based.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made an online partition calculator for ESP32. I made it because calculating this manually is a huge pain, and the only tool I could find was google-sheet based.
